ChallengeResponse.description: Response of `POST /v1/auth/challenge`: a one-time nonce, valid for 60 s.

nonce.description: The nonce to sign (its UTF-8 bytes).

oneOf.description: Authenticate the connection with a session token.
Run a task in a project.

continue.description: Continue with the history of the project.

model.description: Model of the provider; empty = its default.

oneOf.description: Build the project (confirmed in the native dialog).
Cancel the running task or build.
Included in a subscription the user already pays for.

DescribeRequest.description: Request of `POST /v1/graph/describe`: have a model draw the project's map.

lang.description: Language of names and summaries (`en`, `ru`, …); default `en`.

mcp.description: MCP servers loaded by the CLI (Claude Code only).

session.description: Provider's own session id (for native resume), if any.

skills.description: Skills loaded by the CLI (Claude Code only).

oneOf.description: The model calls a tool (shell, edit, read…).

costUsd.description: Cost reported by the provider (API prices), USD.

FileDiffResponse.description: `GET /v1/diff?project=…&path=…`: a file as the project was taken and as it is now.

base.description: Commit the original side comes from (the project's start); absent — no start commit.

binary.description: A side is not UTF-8 text.

modified.description: Text now; absent — the file was deleted, or is binary / too large.

original.description: Text at the start; absent — the file did not exist, or is binary / too large.

tooLarge.description: A side is larger than 2 MiB.

FileResponse.description: `GET /v1/file?project=…&path=…`: a file for the code viewer.

content.description: UTF-8 text; absent for a binary or too large file.

tooLarge.description: Larger than 2 MiB: described, not sent.

ForeignChanges.description: What code from outside the original changes compared with it, so the user sees it before a build. Sorted by file name only; the content is not reviewed.

buildScripts.description: Changed build scripts, installers and CI files.

complete.description: Whether every changed file was checked (false: GitHub's list was cut or not available).

GithubConnectResponse.description: Response of `POST /v1/github/connect`: the code the user enters on GitHub.

connected.description: The agent has a GitHub sign-in.

pending.description: A sign-in code is waiting for the user.

GraphNode.description: A part of a project: a folder (or the files at the root).

changed.description: Files in it added, changed or deleted since the project was taken.

files.description: Number of files in it (including deeper folders shown as their own parts).

id.description: Folder path, `/`-separated; `.` — files at the root.

label.description: Name to show; empty for the files no part of a model's map covers (id `other`).

summary.description: What the part does, one sentence (model's map only).

GraphResponse.description: `GET /v1/graph?project=…`: the map of a project — its parts by folder, and which of them changed since the project was taken.

revision.description: Newest commit of the project; the map changes only with it. Absent — no commits yet.

oneOf.description: A model, in plain words: parts by what they do.
The agent, by folders: no model has described the project yet.

Hello.description: `GET /v1/hello` — the only call that needs neither a session nor an allowed origin.

extraOriginsActive.description: Whether extra web origins are in effect (development builds only). The list itself is not exposed.

ImportRequest.description: Request of `POST /v1/projects/import`: a project from GitHub, without git on the machine.

ref.description: Branch, tag, commit or `pull/<N>/head` of `repo`; absent — its default branch.

repo.description: Where the code comes from: `owner/name` or `https://github.com/owner/name` (the original, or a fork of it).

upstream.description: The original when `repo` is a fork or the ref is a pull request: `owner/name`; absent — `repo` is the original.

commit.description: Commit the project was taken from.

foreign.description: Present when the code is not the original's (a fork or a pull request): what it changes.

JournalEntry.description: One journal entry: a task or a plan step.

commits.description: All commits of the step (the model may commit by itself).

costUsd.description: Cost reported by the provider, USD.

handoff.description: Context came from the journal (another model before).

ModelInfo.description: A model available on this machine.

origin.description: Origin the key is bound to.

projects.description: Projects this browser was given access to.

name.description: Browser name shown in the agent's dialog.

code.description: Code shown both on the page and in the agent's dialog (`123-456`).

oneOf.description: The user blocked it or the dialog timed out.

PlanStepInfo.description: A plan step as shown to the user.

label.description: Model label chosen for the step.

ProjectInfo.description: A project and where its code comes from.

commit.description: Commit the code was taken at.

original.description: The original when the code came from a fork or a pull request: `owner/name`.

source.description: GitHub repository the code was taken from: `owner/name`; absent — not taken from GitHub.

details.description: The same projects with where their code comes from.

PublicJwk.description: A browser's public key (JWK, EC P-256). A private part (`d`) is rejected.

Rating.description: Rating of a task by the Auto mode.

classifier.description: Model that rated the task, or `heuristic`.

decompose.description: The task can be split into steps.

RollbackRequest.description: Request of `POST /v1/rollback`: reset the project to a checkpoint of its journal.

commit.description: A commit listed in the project's journal.

copy.description: Repository to save into (`owner/name`), when the user picked one; otherwise the agent finds or proposes it.

name.description: Name for the repository the user creates.

url.description: Page to open (next step) or the saved work on GitHub.

SaveStep.description: What "Save" did or what the user does next.

oneOf.description: Nothing new since the last save.
Create the copy of the original on github.com (`url`; `name` — a free name for it when the usual one is taken; `next_url` — allowing the app on it, for a private copy).
The project has no original on GitHub: create an empty private repository (`url`, named `name`), then allow the app on it (`next_url`).
Allow the app on the copy (`url`).
The app reaches every repository of the account: leave only the copy (`url`).
The copy has moved on, and these `files` were changed both there and here: nothing saved.
Echo of a text message (connectivity check).
Auto mode rated the task and chose a model.

rating.description: Rating, when planning was chosen by Auto mode.

oneOf.description: A step (or a single task) started.

handoff.description: Context handed over from the journal.

resume.description: Native resume of the provider's session.

oneOf.description: Raw stderr of a provider CLI.

plan.description: The task ran as a plan.

oneOf.description: Whether the machine will manage the build.
An error; for auth errors the connection is closed after it.

signature.description: ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 signature of the nonce, IEEE P1363 (r‖s), base64url.

token.description: Bearer token; kept in memory only.

StepInfo.description: Position of a step in a plan.

Usage.description: Token usage reported by a provider.
